question: Calculate the percentage of carcinogenic molecules with triple bonded Hidrogen atoms.
evidence: hydrogen refers to element = 'h'; label = '+' mean molecules are carcinogenic; triple bond refers to bond_type = '#'; percentage = DIVIDE(SUM(label = '+'), COUNT(molecule_id)) * 100.0 where element = 'h' AND bond_type = '#';
clarification: Count every row, including repeated molecule_id values.
gold: SELECT CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN T1.label = '+' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) * 100 / COUNT(T1.molecule_id) FROM molecule AS T1 INNER JOIN atom AS T2 ON T1.molecule_id = T2.molecule_id INNER JOIN bond AS T3 ON T1.molecule_id = T3.molecule_id WHERE T3.bond_type = '#' AND T2.element = 'h'
gold0: SELECT CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN T1.label = '+' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) * 100 / COUNT(DISTINCT T1.molecule_id) FROM molecule AS T1 INNER JOIN atom AS T2 ON T1.molecule_id = T2.molecule_id INNER JOIN bond AS T3 ON T1.molecule_id = T3.molecule_id WHERE T3.bond_type = '#' AND T2.element = 'h'

c.sql: SELECT 100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN m.label = '+' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(m.molecule_id) AS percentage FROM molecule m JOIN atom a ON m.molecule_id = a.molecule_id JOIN bond b ON m.molecule_id = b.molecule_id WHERE a.element = 'h' AND b.bond_type = '#'

d.request: What percentage of carcinogenic molecules (label = '+') are there among triple-bonded (bond_type = '#') hydrogen (element = 'h') atoms, when every row is counted, including repeated molecule_id values? Calculate it as SUM(label = '+') divided by COUNT(molecule_id), multiplied by 100.0.
d.sql: SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN m.label = '+' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 100.0 / COUNT(m.molecule_id) FROM molecule m INNER JOIN atom a ON m.molecule_id = a.molecule_id INNER JOIN bond b ON m.molecule_id = b.molecule_id WHERE b.bond_type = '#' AND a.element = 'h'

b.request: Compute the percentage of carcinogenic (label = '+') rows among all rows from joining molecule, atom (element = 'h'), and bond (bond_type = '#'), counting every joined row, including repeated molecule_id values, rather than distinct molecules
b.sql: SELECT CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN m.label = '+' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) * 100 / COUNT(*) AS percentage FROM molecule m INNER JOIN atom a ON m.molecule_id = a.molecule_id INNER JOIN bond b ON m.molecule_id = b.molecule_id WHERE a.element = 'h' AND b.bond_type = '#'
